svg.title: AI in the Real World: Data, Power, & Society. CMSE 492, Spring 2027.
svg.desc: Course poster. Headline: AI is already in your field. Can you tell when it's wrong? An illustrative plot shows a model's prediction matching the data it was trained on, then continuing upward while real observations fall away. CMSE 492 meets Monday and Wednesday, 2:40 to 4:00 pm, in Ag Hall 8. Natural science students encouraged; all majors welcome; no programming experience required. Course website: https://msucerl.org/cmse101/. Contact: caball14@msu.edu.

path.aria-label: DATA THE MODEL WAS TRAINED ON
in conditions it had never seen
AI in the Real World: Data, Power, & Society
Climate models. Medical images. Agriculture. Scientific research. Trace how AI
works in practice, and learn to use, evaluate, question, and push back on it.
Natural science students encouraged. All majors welcome.
